name: 尖嘴狐仙
evolution: 灵狐 → 九尾狐 Lv.30 → 尖嘴狐仙 Lv.50
description: 尖嘴狐仙能通过感知大地的温度变化来预测农时。当它摇着尾巴经过农田时，尾巴扇动的气流会形成特殊的暖湿环流，让田地在寒冷的初春也能保持适宜作物生长的温度。
descriptionEn: The Pointed-fox Immortal can predict farming seasons by sensing changes in the earth's temperature. When it swishes its tail past fields, the airflow forms a special warm, humid circulation that keeps the land at a temperature fit for crops even in the cold early spring.

skills.name: 冷风
skills.description: 对敌方精灵造成魔法伤害。
skills.descriptionEn: Deals magic damage to the enemy.

skills.name: 防御
skills.descriptionEn: Reduces damage by 70%, in response to attacks.

skills.name: 炎枪
skills.description: 对敌方精灵造成魔法伤害。
skills.descriptionEn: Deals magic damage to the enemy.

skills.name: 焚烧烙印
skills.description: 驱散双方所有印记，每驱散1层，敌方获得5层灼烧。
skills.descriptionEn: Dispel all marks from both sides; for each mark dispelled, enemy gains 5 Burn stacks.

skills.name: 火焰切割
skills.description: 对敌方精灵造成物理伤害。
skills.descriptionEn: Deals physical damage to the enemy.

skills.name: 充分燃烧
skills.description: 使敌方身上的灼烧翻倍，并触发1次灼烧伤害。
skills.descriptionEn: Doubles the enemy's Burn stacks and triggers 1 Burn damage.

skills.name: 火焰护盾
skills.description: 减伤70%，应对攻击：敌方获得6层灼烧。
skills.descriptionEn: Reduce damage 70%; respond to attacks: enemy gains 6 Burn stacks.

skills.name: 暴风雪
skills.description: 造成物伤，敌方获得1层冻结。
skills.descriptionEn: Deals physical damage; enemy gains 1 Freeze stack.

skills.name: 冬至
skills.description: 将天气改为暴风雪，持续8回合。
skills.descriptionEn: Change weather to Blizzard for 8 turns.

skills.name: 冰点
skills.description: 敌方获得5层冻结，应对防御：额外获得5层。
skills.descriptionEn: Enemy gains 5 Freeze stacks; respond to defense: additionally gains 5.

skills.name: 易燃物质
skills.description: 造成魔伤，2连击，每次连击使敌方获得2层灼烧。
skills.descriptionEn: Deals magic damage; 2 hits; each hit gives enemy 2 Burn stacks.

skills.name: 热身
skills.description: 下一次攻击时，技能威力翻倍，应对防御：改为威力变为4倍。
skills.descriptionEn: On next attack, skill power doubles; respond to defense: power becomes 4x.

skills.name: 爆裂飞弹
skills.description: 对敌方精灵造成魔法伤害。
skills.descriptionEn: Deals magic damage to the enemy.
